title: End-to-end serial-audio and clock contract is not proven
component_interface: TLV320ADC5140 to RT1062 to TAS5825M audio and clocks
description: The product names TDM/I2S and stereo I2S but does not freeze a supported end-to-end mode, mastership, sample/frame format, clock relationships, logic levels, timing margins or latency. Internal Board A and cross-board compatibility must be demonstrated before architecture freeze.

evidence.note: The named audio links are product intent; complete clock/protocol compatibility is not established.
Two 96-kHz candidate digital links are architecture compatible; exact clock phase/pin/timing and latency remain R3 open.

R3 disposition: R3 selects ADC TDM four 32-bit slots at 96 kHz (12.288-MHz BCLK) and amp stereo I2S two 32-bit slots (6.144-MHz BCLK), RT1062 master on both, common 24-MHz reference/audio-PLL family and no cross-board MCLK. R4 loaded edge, mux/divider, DMA and full latency proof remains. Earlier R1 criterion remains in repository history. Prior R1 status=open, blocker=R3, closure criterion: Before R3 PASS, use R2 authoritative endpoint evidence to approve one end-to-end ADC→RT1062→amplifier clock/audio contract, including master roles, rate/slot/frame formats, logic levels, loaded timing, startup and latency budget; decide MCLK inclusion by evidence and identify resource/DMA feasibility.
R4 preflight reviewed this finding. R4 electrical closure remains blocked; no R5 schematic approval.

Public official evidence and conditional calculations reviewed; closure criterion is not yet satisfied. Current NXP RM Rev 4 / HW Guide Rev 7 access restriction applies to the RT1062 portions. Finding remains blocking, with original history preserved.

evidence.location: section 10, authorized-manual and owner-input closure audit, 2026-09-30
evidence.note: NXP RM Rev 4 pp.1028,1052,1056-1058,1977-2020 supports 24 MHz->PLL4 786.432 MHz/4->SAI roots 24.576 MHz->12.288/6.144 MHz BCLK; different SAI units lack hardware synchronous mode. ADC receive half-cycle has only 7.69 ns conditional setup before skew at 25 C/20 pF; full loaded/temp/DMA/latency proof remains open.

TI ADC supports four 24-bit TDM words; NXP PLL4 884.736 MHz candidate gives 9.216-MHz ADC BCLK and conditional 16.25-ns setup room at 25 C/20 pF/5-ns assumed skew. This is not frozen or full-temperature proof; R3 32-bit baseline remains.

closure_criterion: Verify exact SAI mux/clock dividers/frame phase, loaded setup/hold across connector, 3.3-V corner levels, DMA continuity and complete input-to-speaker latency before R4 schematic readiness.
resolved_by: R3 architecture disposition; later closure required
resolution: R3 selects ADC TDM four 32-bit slots at 96 kHz (12.288-MHz BCLK) and amp stereo I2S two 32-bit slots (6.144-MHz BCLK), RT1062 master on both, common 24-MHz reference/audio-PLL family and no cross-board MCLK. R4 loaded edge, mux/divider, DMA and full latency proof remains.
